segments.text: Pon ping alerts you when clawed code finishes with Warcraft 3 pon voices.
Install with one curl command and get ready to work on start work work on completion. Something need doing for permission prompts. Tab titles update
with status dots. Mac OS notifications pop when terminal isn't focused. Spam prompts too fast and your PN tells you to chill. Four sound packs included.
